A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same AutoLibra study. The main text, ten figures, ten tables, and Appendices A–O are readable and can be matched despite extensive reformatting.

before.justification: v1 reports original human-validation results, metric coverage and ablation results, and agent-improvement experiments, including detailed appendix results.

after.justification: v2 retains those original empirical results in Table 1, Figure 7, Table 3, and the game-agent and WebVoyager appendices.

M1.justification: The feedback grounding, behavior clustering, agent judging, meta-evaluation, and iterative optimization procedures remain unchanged. Algorithm 1 and the appendix prompts retain the same procedures.

E1.justification: Both versions use CoGym, Sotopia, WebArena, WebVoyager, Baba-Is-AI, and MiniHack, plus NNetNav-live trajectories for web-agent fine-tuning. The represented tasks and held-out scenarios are unchanged.

E2.justification: The expert-category comparisons in Table 2, unmodified-agent baselines in Tables 5 and 7, and goal-completion LLM-as-a-Judge comparator in Section 5.2 remain the same.

E3.justification: The reported splits, model choices, iteration schedules, and evaluation procedures are retained, including six of forty Baba-Is-AI tasks for optimization, the 100-step game limit, and top-10% trajectory selection for fine-tuning. No experimental setting is substantively revised.

E4.justification: Figure 7 retains the metric-count analysis and ablation removing behavior examples. Cross-model and held-out evaluations in Section 5.1 and the qualitative and failure analyses in Appendices H and N are unchanged.

E5.justification: Table 1 retains forty sampled instances per step and task and the same uncertainty reporting for average agreement. Neither version adds or removes repeated-run, seed, confidence-interval, or significance-testing information relative to the other.

E6.justification: Matched numerical entries, plotted results, and qualitative findings are unchanged. For example, both Table 3 versions report iteration-0 to iteration-3 success rates of 33.3% to 52.7% for Baba-Is-AI and 34.8% to 39.7% for WebVoyager; appendix result tables also match.

T1.justification: Section 2 retains the aspect triple, trait classifications, and definitions of coverage and redundancy. No assumptions, mathematical reasoning, theorems, or proofs are added or substantively revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about feedback-induced behavioral metrics, generalizable evaluation, and agent improvement. Adding 'AI' and 'Human' to the title makes the existing scope explicit without changing the contribution.

C2.justification: Interpretations and applicability limits are retained, including the Corridor generalization failure in Appendix N.2. 'Limitation and Ethics Statement' becomes 'Broader Impact Statement,' but its text-only scope, annotator-diversity limitations, and LLM-bias cautions remain unchanged.

D1.justification: Section 3.1 clarifies '20 different metrics' as '20 different sets of metrics,' improving the precision of the documented candidate search without establishing a changed procedure or budget. Model details, appendix prompts, configurations, and code/data access information otherwise remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The cited works and research positioning remain the same, including the relationships to agent evaluation, learning from language feedback, and automatic thematic analysis. Bibliographic typography changes do not introduce different references.

P1.justification: v2 revises the title, clarifies the candidate-set wording, renames the limitations heading, removes the preprint header text, and adds a DARPA funding acknowledgment. The substantive prose and section organization are otherwise retained.

P2.justification: The document undergoes broad retypesetting: fonts, text width, title and abstract layout, figure sizing, table layout, and appendix-box pagination change throughout. Figures 1, 4, and 8 move, and Figure 4's caption is shortened. The underlying figures and table contents are retained.

improvement.justification: The substantive study and supporting appendices are unchanged. The candidate-set clarification and enlarged figures offer small readability benefits, while reflow creates additional isolated prompt continuations on mostly empty pages. These limited presentation tradeoffs leave overall paper quality effectively unchanged.
